hook: Your fastest human-made object touched the Sun.
title: The Probe That Touched the Sun at 692,000 km/h
description:
NASA's Parker Solar Probe flew through the Sun's corona and reached about 692,000 km/h in December 2024. It is the fastest human-made object ever. It survives on a heat shield built for the job.

#Shorts #Space #NASA
